title: Cardamom Custard Ice Cream
description: A delicately spiced ice cream made from cardamom-infused milk and custard powder. Perfect alongside a fruity dessert or rhubarb crumble.
steps: Line a 500ml freezer-safe container with cling film.
Put the milk and cardamom pods in a saucepan and heat slowly over medium heat for 5–10 minutes to infuse.
Mix the custard powder with a few tablespoons of the warm milk to form a paste. Pour the rest of the milk over the paste, stirring. Return to the saucepan and heat until thickened.
Remove from heat, fish out the cardamom pods, and beat with an electric whisk until light and fluffy.
Pour into the container. Freeze for 30 minutes, stir, and return. Repeat at least 6 times over 3 hours, then leave to set completely.
notes: Serves 6. The repeated stirring replaces an ice cream maker.
